name: Star names
description: A CSV table linking star names and multilingual translations to source identifiers and catalog designations, including Bayer, Flamsteed, HD and Hipparcos fields where supplied. Derived from d3-celestial without geometry; it is independent of the magnitude-limited position subsets.
citeAs: Part of Celestial Data (1.0.1), collection DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7561601. The DOI identifies the archived collection, not a separate DOI for this dataset.

recordSet.name: records
recordSet.description: One record per source feature or CSV row in its original order. No values are imputed. Publication dates describe the collection release, not observations; J2000 is a celestial reference epoch, not a file date. The row-position key is local to this snapshot.

field.name: record_index
field.description: One-based row position in this source snapshot; unique within this record set, not an astronomical catalog identifier or a persistent cross-release key. CSV text is preserved literally: empty cells remain empty strings and the literal NA is not converted to JSON null.

field.name: id
field.description: Identifier as stored in this source catalog, preserving its original text or numeric representation. It is not assumed unique across catalogs or records. CSV text is preserved literally: empty cells remain empty strings and the literal NA is not converted to JSON null.

field.name: name
field.description: Name stored in the source; its convention depends on the catalog. Nulls and empty strings are preserved, not filled from another language. CSV text is preserved literally: empty cells remain empty strings and the literal NA is not converted to JSON null.

field.name: bayer
field.description: Bayer designation stored as text in the names table. CSV text is preserved literally: empty cells remain empty strings and the literal NA is not converted to JSON null.

field.name: flam
